glc_source: NASA Global Landslide Catalog Export (glc_legacy.csv), AOI-filtered
rainfall_source: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive API (daily precipitation_sum), antecedent window strictly T-14..T-1; no zero-fill or synthetic substitution
dem_source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (30 m), tiles N27E088 + N28E088, merged and clipped to AOI
terrain_derivative_method: app.services.terrain_processing.process_dem_in_chunks (slope, aspect, roughness, tpi; chunked at 512 px)
exposure_source: NOT USED as a model feature in this run
spatial_split: Latitude median split (South vs North East Sikkim)
negative_sampling: Spatially buffered random points, >= 0.05 deg (~5 km) from any positive, 3:1 ratio, seed 42

leakage_controls.spatial_leakage: MITIGATED: buffered negative sampling (>= 0.05 deg) + latitude-median spatial holdout.
leakage_controls.temporal_leakage: MITIGATED: strict temporal holdout (train <= 2014 vs test >= 2015).
leakage_controls.future_rainfall_leakage: MITIGATED: antecedent rainfall strictly from T-14..T-1.

additional_context.aoi_source: app.core.config_states.EAST_SIKKIM_PILOT_AOI -- the single canonical pilot AOI used for tile selection, DEM crop, GLC filter and negative sampling.
additional_context.note: Trained from the Phase-3F-audited training_matrix.parquet (SHA pinned above); DEM/terrain/rainfall stages were executed and verified in Phases 3C-3F.
